experiment_design.primary_question: Does pre-dispatch telemetry provide material incremental predictive/ranking value once planned logistics are already present?

baseline.p1: crop-conditioned training median loss_fraction_pct, fallback to global training median
baseline.p2: per-fold crop-conditioned training median loss_fraction_pct, fallback to global training median of fold

preprocessing.fitting_rule: Fitted strictly on training partition/fold only
